<?php

class SecureAPIGateway {
    private $db;
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $tokenCache = [];
    private $auditLog = [];
    
    public function __construct($dbConfig) {
        $this->db = new PDO(
            "mysql:host={$dbConfig['host']};dbname={$dbConfig['db']};charset=utf8mb4",
            $dbConfig['user'],
            $dbConfig['pass'],
            [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]
        );
        $this->rateLimiter = new RateLimiter();
    }
    
    public function handleRequest($request) {
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->check($request['ip'])) {
            return $this->errorResponse(429, 'Rate limit exceeded');
        }
        
        $token = $this->extractBearerToken($request);
        if ($token === null) {
            return $this->errorResponse(401, 'Missing authentication token');
        }
        
        $session = $this->validateToken($token);
        if ($session === false) {
            return $this->errorResponse(401, 'Invalid or expired token');
        }
        
        $route = $this->resolveRoute($request['method'], $request['path']);
        if ($route === null) {
            return $this->errorResponse(404, 'Not found');
        }
        
        if (!$this->checkPermission($session, $route)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(403, 'Forbidden');
        }
        
        return $this->dispatch($route, $session, $request);
    }
    
    private function extractBearerToken($request) {
        $header = $request['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '';
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i', $header, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function validateToken($token) {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }
        
        list($header, $payload, $signature) = $parts;
        
        $decodedPayload = json_decode(base64_decode($payload), true);
        if (!$decodedPayload || !isset($decodedPayload['sub']) || !isset($decodedPayload['exp'])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        if ($decodedPayload['exp'] < time()) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $expectedSignature = $this->computeSignature($header, $payload, $decodedPayload['sub']);
        
        if ($this->verifySignature($signature, $expectedSignature) == true) {
            return $this->loadSession($decodedPayload);
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private function computeSignature($header, $payload, $userId) {
        $secret = $this->getSigningKey($userId);
        $data = $header . '.' . $payload;
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $secret);
    }
    
    private function getSigningKey($userId) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT signing_key FROM user_keys WHERE user_id = ? AND active = 1');
        $stmt->execute([$userId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$row) {
            return getenv('DEFAULT_SIGNING_KEY');
        }
        return $row['signing_key'];
    }
    
    private function verifySignature($provided, $expected) {
        if (strlen($provided) === 0 || strlen($expected) === 0) {
            return false;
        }
        // Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
        $result = 0;
        $len = max(strlen($provided), strlen($expected));
        $provided = str_pad($provided, $len, "\0");
        $expected = str_pad($expected, $len, "\0");
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $result |= ord($provided[$i]) ^ ord($expected[$i]);
        }
        return $result;
    }
    
    private function loadSession($payload) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT u.id, u.username, u.role, u.department FROM users u WHERE u.id = ? AND u.active = 1'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$payload['sub']]);
        $user = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$user) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return [
            'user' => $user,
            'permissions' => $this->loadPermissions($user['id'], $user['role']),
            'issued_at' => $payload['iat'] ?? time(),
            'expires_at' => $payload['exp']
        ];
    }
    
    private function loadPermissions($userId, $role) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT permission FROM role_permissions WHERE role = ? UNION SELECT permission FROM user_permissions WHERE user_id = ?'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$role, $userId]);
        return $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
    }
    
    private function resolveRoute($method, $path) {
        $routes = [
            'GET' => [
                '/api/users' => ['handler' => 'listUsers', 'permission' => 'users.read'],
                '/api/admin/config' => ['handler' => 'getConfig', 'permission' => 'admin.config'],
                '/api/reports' => ['handler' => 'getReports', 'permission' => 'reports.read'],
            ],
            'POST' => [
                '/api/users' => ['handler' => 'createUser', 'permission' => 'users.write'],
                '/api/admin/config' => ['handler' => 'updateConfig', 'permission' => 'admin.config'],
                '/api/admin/keys/rotate' => ['handler' => 'rotateKeys', 'permission' => 'admin.keys'],
            ],
            'DELETE' => [
                '/api/users' => ['handler' => 'deleteUser', 'permission' => 'users.delete'],
            ]
        ];
        
        return $routes[$method][$path] ?? null;
    }
    
    private function checkPermission($session, $route) {
        $required = $route['permission'];
        return in_array($required, $session['permissions'], true);
    }
    
    private function dispatch($route, $session, $request) {
        $handler = $route['handler'];
        $this->auditLog[] = [
            'user' => $session['user']['username'],
            'action' => $handler,
            'time' => time(),
            'ip' => $request['ip']
        ];
        return $this->$handler($session, $request);
    }
    
    private function listUsers($session, $request) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT id, username, role, department FROM users WHERE active = 1');
        $stmt->execute();
        return $this->jsonResponse(200, $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC));
    }
    
    private function createUser($session, $request) {
        $data = $request['body'];
        if (!isset($data['username']) || !isset($data['password']) || !isset($data['role'])) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Missing required fields');
        }
        
        $username = trim($data['username']);
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,32}$/', $username)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Invalid username format');
        }
        
        $allowedRoles = ['viewer', 'editor', 'moderator'];
        if (!in_array($data['role'], $allowedRoles, true)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Invalid role');
        }
        
        $hashedPassword = password_hash($data['password'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role, department, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([$username, $hashedPassword, $data['role'], $data['department'] ?? 'general']);
        
        return $this->jsonResponse(201, ['id' => $this->db->lastInsertId(), 'username' => $username]);
    }
    
    private function deleteUser($session, $request) {
        $userId = $request['body']['user_id'] ?? null;
        if (!$userId || !is_numeric($userId)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Invalid user ID');
        }
        
        if ((int)$userId === (int)$session['user']['id']) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Cannot delete yourself');
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE users SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?');
        $stmt->execute([(int)$userId]);
        
        return $this->jsonResponse(200, ['deleted' => true]);
    }
    
    private function getConfig($session, $request) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT config_key, config_value FROM system_config');
        $stmt->execute();
        return $this->jsonResponse(200, $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_KEY_PAIR));
    }
    
    private function updateConfig($session, $request) {
        $data = $request['body'];
        if (!isset($data['key']) || !isset($data['value'])) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Missing key or value');
        }
        
        $allowedKeys = ['site_name', 'maintenance_mode', 'max_upload_size', 'session_timeout'];
        if (!in_array($data['key'], $allowedKeys, true)) {
            return $this->errorResponse(400, 'Invalid config key');
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE system_config SET config_value = ? WHERE config_key = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$data['value'], $data['key']]);
        
        return $this->jsonResponse(200, ['updated' => true]);
    }
    
    private function getReports($session, $request) {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT id, title, created_at FROM reports WHERE department = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50');
        $stmt->execute([$session['user']['department']]);
        return $this->jsonResponse(200, $stmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC));
    }
    
    private function rotateKeys($session, $request) {
        $newKey = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('UPDATE user_keys SET active = 0 WHERE user_id = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$session['user']['id']]);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO user_keys (user_id, signing_key, active, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 1, NOW())');
        $stmt->execute([$session['user']['id'], $newKey]);
        
        return $this->jsonResponse(200, ['rotated' => true]);
    }
    
    private function jsonResponse($code, $data) {
        return ['status' => $code, 'body' => json_encode($data), 'headers' => ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']];
    }
    
    private function errorResponse($code, $message) {
        return ['status' => $code, 'body' => json_encode(['error' => $message]), 'headers' => ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']];
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private $requests = [];
    
    public function check($ip) {
        $now = time();
        $this->requests[$ip] = array_filter(
            $this->requests[$ip] ?? [],
            function($t) use ($now) { return $t > $now - 60; }
        );
        $this->requests[$ip][] = $now;
        return count($this->requests[$ip]) <= 100;
    }
}
